# Guide India Tours

> Guide India Tours is a government-approved private tour operator based in Agra, India, specializing in expertly guided tours of the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, and the wider Golden Triangle (Delhi–Agra–Jaipur). Rated 4.9 stars with 400+ verified Google reviews.

## About
Guide India Tours provides private, licensed tour guides and door-to-door tour packages across North India. All guides are approved by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India. We work directly with travelers — no middlemen.

## Services
- Private Taj Mahal guided tours (sunrise and daytime)
- Same-day Taj Mahal tours from Delhi (by car and by express train)
- Agra city tours (Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Fatehpur Sikri, Itmad-ud-Daulah)
- Golden Triangle tours (Delhi, Agra, Jaipur) — 3 days and longer
- Rajasthan and multi-city custom India tour packages
- Airport and hotel pickup across Delhi NCR and Agra

## Key Information
- Location: Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Guides: Government-approved, licensed by the Ministry of Tourism
- Languages: English, Hindi
- Booking: Via WhatsApp (+91 8979810991) or website enquiry form
- Rating: 4.9 stars, 400+ Google reviews
